data: Which of the following reach a percentage value more than 20 in the right plot?

The right plot shows the percentage of entries without any annotation for both Swiss-Prot and TrEMBL databases over time. The y-axis represents the percentage of entries, ranging from 0 to 100%. The x-axis represents the database release date.

To determine which percentages exceed 20%, I will analyze the data points on the right plot:

1. **Swiss-Prot**: The blue dots represent the percentage of entries without annotation for Swiss-Prot. These values are consistently below 20% throughout the entire timeline shown in the plot. Therefore, no Swiss-Prot data point exceeds 20%.

2. **TrEMBL**: The red dots represent the percentage of entries without annotation for TrEMBL. These values start at approximately 20% and decrease over time but remain above 20% throughout the entire timeline shown in the plot.

Based on this analysis, only the TrEMBL data points reach a percentage value more than 20% in the right plot.
